ios.desc:
Invest like an icon
We power crypto access for everyone: from private people, to pros, to public companies. Here since the beginning of crypto.

Earn up to 11% APY on 50+ assets (Rates are variable and not guaranteed)
Choose Flexible Rewards for more flexibility, or Fixed-Term Rewards for boosted rates over a set term.

Be Your Own Bank®
Whatever your crypto goals, our combined Trading and DeFi platform gets you there:
Deposit: Add funds from your bank or card and start with as little as a few dollars
Buy: Buy trending tokens with just a couple taps from your phone
Sell: Turn your crypto back into cash whenever you need it
Swap: Instantly trade one crypto for another without leaving the app
Send: Send crypto securely anywhere, with support for multi-chain wallets
Earn: Put your holdings to work with transparent, variable reward rates
Loan: Access liquidity from 1.9% per year without selling 
Perps: Trade crypto price movements with up to 50x leverage
DeFi: Connect to DApps, manage NFTs, and explore web3 in one wallet

5700+ tradable assets
Our DeFi Wallet supports thousands of assets across multiple chains.

One of the world’s most loved crypto apps
Our powerful trading platform and integrated DeFi wallet give you complete access to the future of finance.

Trusted  since 2011
- Security first: No customer has lost funds due to a security breach (as of Jan 2026)
- Used by millions: Over 94M wallets (as of Jan 2026) have been created to date and growing.
- Digital asset hub: We’ve handled over $1.2T worth of transactions

Discover the big wide world of DeFi
- Connect to DApps, manage NFTs, and access DeFi, all from a self-custody wallet where you control your keys
- Support for major networks like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Polygon
- Connect to DeFi protocols and NFT marketplaces in a few taps
- You’re in control: your keys, your crypto

For our most loyal clients (Invite-only)
As your relationship with us grows, you’ll unlock a more personalized experience
- Concierge care: 24/7 White-glove support with a dedicated point of contact
- Enhanced Incentives: Preferred opportunities on select yield products and early feature access
- Insider Insights: Invite-only market updates and advanced online sessions
- Events & Access: Access to private dinners, select conferences, and premium sporting events (where available)

Get started in three simple steps
1. Create your account: Sign up and complete verification in a few minutes
2. Deposit or buy crypto: Add funds or buy
